0.original: Erenville would propose a course of action.

48.original: Right! Time to track down the next elector!

49.original: A heavenly land, suffused with a golden glow...

50.original: With only two keystones remaining, we've at last begun to gain a fuller picture of the legend of the golden city.

51.original: What a turn of events─we were only meant to strengthen the ice, but Bakool Ja Ja's idiocy forced us to do them one better.

52.original: Long has it been since any from Chirwagur Saltern have deigned to enter Worlar's Echo. A day for unusual visitors, indeed.

53.original: Watching Vorporlor get caught up in Wuk Lamat's unstoppable wake reminds me of my younger days...

54.original: I think it's time we returned to Tuliyollal. After scaling Tural's tallest mountain and battling a legendary beast to the death, even dauntless heroes like you could probably use a rest.

55.original: In any case, there are preparations to be made before we can visit the next destination laid out in the saga.

56.original: The respite would be most welcome. I believe I hear the For'ard Cabins calling our names.

57.original: I'll take the opportunity to think on some things.

58.original: No sooner did we set foot back in Tuliyollal than I felt the weight of recent events set in all at once. I am definitely due for a long nap.

60.original: <yawn> I won't say no to clean sheets and a soft pillow.

61.original: There are still two feats left to go. We want to face them refreshed and ready for action.

62.original: Welcome back to Tuliyollal. Your cabins are waiting for you.

63.original: Rest well, everyone. We can meet back here later on.

64.original: I have a small errand to run in the city, so I'll leave you to recover.

65.original: Will you be heading to the palace, Wuk Lamat?

67.original: Lost in her own little world, it seems. Well, no matter─I'll be back soon enough.

68.original: An attendant is standing by to unlock your cabin. Enjoy your stay!

70.original: The rite of succession must be an absolutely exhausting endeavor. The comforts of our cabins are at your disposal whenever you wish to retire, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>.

71.original: Welcome back, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Your cabin is just as you left it─minus a light layer of dust!

73.original: Sorry to drag you away from your nice, comfortable cabin, but I could feel the walls closing in.

74.original: Oh, I know! I'll take you to one of my favorite places in Tuliyollal─that should help me get my thoughts in order.

75.original: We'll go to the Resplendent Quarter and make our way up from there!

76.original: Oh, hello, dear. You're one of Wuk Lamat's new friends...?

77.original: Peshiwa, what are you doing up and about? Is your back feeling better?

78.original: It's much healed now, so don't make a fuss. Besides, I can't be lounging in bed all day when you're out there fighting your hardest to win the throne.

79.original: You're the claimant with the greatest love for peace.

80.original: I love this nation of ours, and lending you my support is the least I can do.

81.original: When I see you smile like that, how can I not be encouraged?

82.original: Oh ho ho, there's plenty more who believe in your cause. I can recruit a whole battalion of smiling faces if you think it'll help!

83.original: Yours alone is more than enough. Thank you, Peshiwa!

84.original: And thank you, Third Promise. I shall pray for your success in the contest.

87.original: It's just that with the progress we've made in the contest, even these everyday encounters feel that much more special.

88.original: Do you think we can take our time, and maybe wander around a little first? Then we can head to that spot I was thinking of.

89.original: You look to be in good spirits. I assume your leisure time was well spent.

90.original: I was glad to snatch some quality sleep, myself. After all, it will soon be back to the road for us!
